$comment: Source of truth for Poxeet design tokens. Same shape as the Poxeet design system artifact. Edit here, then run pnpm tokens:build.
name: Poxeet

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background in the app and below the marketing hero.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs, the calendar grid and the post preview.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: draft chips, skeletons, table headers, the inactive half of a segmented control.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decorative only; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, switches and secondary buttons (3:1 on surface and canvas in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on canvas, surface, surface-muted and both washes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, captions and placeholders on canvas, surface, surface-muted and both washes (4.5:1 or more everywhere).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button: Poxeet cobalt, the one main action on a screen.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on hover and press.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an action fill.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Poxeet cobalt: links, the Approved status, selected days, the focus ring, the brand button. As text on canvas, surface, surface-muted and brand-soft.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Brand button fill and link color on hover.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind brand text: the Approved badge, today's cell, eyebrow pills.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Label on a brand fill. Dark text in the dark theme because the dark brand is light.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Posted status and connected states. As text on the surfaces and success-soft; always paired with the double-check icon and a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the Posted badge and success banners.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs check, missed, token expiring. As text on the surfaces and warning-soft; always with the clock or alert icon and a word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of warning badges and banners.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed status, destructive buttons, field errors, the over-limit counter. As text on the surfaces and danger-soft; always with the alert icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the Failed badge, critical banners and the destructive button's hover.

tokens.name: wash-cool
tokens.usage: Cool stop of the showroom glow behind the hero and the closing call to action. Ink and ink-muted read on it. Never inside the app.

tokens.name: wash-warm
tokens.usage: Warm stop of the showroom glow. Ink and ink-muted read on it. Never inside the app.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind the modal and the day panel on phones.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring color, an alias of brand (3:1 or more on every surface).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Workroom page ground: a warm off-white, not grey. Workroom only (the signed-in app is light only, so one value serves both themes).

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Workroom quiet fills: inactive segments, chips, table heads, skeletons.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Workroom hairlines between rows and inside cards. Decorative only.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Workroom control borders and the faintest icons (3.4:1 on surface).

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Workroom ink and the fill of its primary button: a warm near-black.

tokens.name: graphite-hover
tokens.usage: Workroom primary button on hover.

tokens.name: graphite-muted
tokens.usage: Workroom secondary text, metadata and captions (5.2:1 on paper, 5.7:1 on surface).

tokens.name: iris
tokens.usage: Workroom accent: selection, today, Approve, links, focus, the selected day's posts (5.9:1 with white).

tokens.name: iris-hover
tokens.usage: Iris on hover and as text on iris-soft.

tokens.name: iris-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind iris text: Approved tags, the current nav item's icon tile, selected rows.

tokens.name: iris-wash
tokens.usage: The lavender ground of the calendar board and the job panel.

tokens.name: iris-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines on iris-wash.

tokens.name: tone-0
tokens.usage: Pillar tone 0, lilac: the light tint (legend chips, badges, tinted grounds). Text: tone-0-ink.

tokens.name: tone-0-ink
tokens.usage: Text on tone-0 and on tints between it and the solid (11.4:1 on the tint).

tokens.name: tone-0-solid
tokens.usage: Pillar tone 0, lilac, at full strength: approved and selected posts, bold blocks. Text: tone-0-on.

tokens.name: tone-0-on
tokens.usage: Text and icons on tone-0-solid (5.9:1).

tokens.name: tone-1
tokens.usage: Pillar tone 1, orange: the light tint (legend chips, badges, tinted grounds). Text: tone-1-ink.

tokens.name: tone-1-ink
tokens.usage: Text on tone-1 and on tints between it and the solid (9.7:1 on the tint).

tokens.name: tone-1-solid
tokens.usage: Pillar tone 1, orange, at full strength: approved and selected posts, bold blocks. Text: tone-1-on.

tokens.name: tone-1-on
tokens.usage: Text and icons on tone-1-solid (6.9:1).

tokens.name: tone-2
tokens.usage: Pillar tone 2, cyan: the light tint (legend chips, badges, tinted grounds). Text: tone-2-ink.

tokens.name: tone-2-ink
tokens.usage: Text on tone-2 and on tints between it and the solid (9.5:1 on the tint).

tokens.name: tone-2-solid
tokens.usage: Pillar tone 2, cyan, at full strength: approved and selected posts, bold blocks. Text: tone-2-on.

tokens.name: tone-2-on
tokens.usage: Text and icons on tone-2-solid (7.5:1).

tokens.name: tone-3
tokens.usage: Pillar tone 3, yellow: the light tint (legend chips, badges, tinted grounds). Text: tone-3-ink.

tokens.name: tone-3-ink
tokens.usage: Text on tone-3 and on tints between it and the solid (10.1:1 on the tint).

tokens.name: tone-3-solid
tokens.usage: Pillar tone 3, yellow, at full strength: approved and selected posts, bold blocks. Text: tone-3-on.

tokens.name: tone-3-on
tokens.usage: Text and icons on tone-3-solid (9.4:1).

tokens.name: tone-4
tokens.usage: Pillar tone 4, lime: the light tint (legend chips, badges, tinted grounds). Text: tone-4-ink.

tokens.name: tone-4-ink
tokens.usage: Text on tone-4 and on tints between it and the solid (9.5:1 on the tint).

tokens.name: tone-4-solid
tokens.usage: Pillar tone 4, lime, at full strength: approved and selected posts, bold blocks. Text: tone-4-on.

tokens.name: tone-4-on
tokens.usage: Text and icons on tone-4-solid (8.5:1).

tokens.name: tone-5
tokens.usage: Pillar tone 5, plum: the light tint (legend chips, badges, tinted grounds). Text: tone-5-ink.

tokens.name: tone-5-ink
tokens.usage: Text on tone-5 and on tints between it and the solid (8.5:1 on the tint).

tokens.name: tone-5-solid
tokens.usage: Pillar tone 5, plum, at full strength: approved and selected posts, bold blocks. Text: tone-5-on.

tokens.name: tone-5-on
tokens.usage: Text and icons on tone-5-solid (8.6:1).

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Marketing and page titles. Medium weight with tight tracking; size carries the emphasis.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Stay visible on LinkedIn without living on it.
styles.usage: Landing hero headline only. Drops to display-lg below 768px.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.sample: A month of posts that sound like you.
styles.usage: Marketing section headlines and the hero on tablets.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Smaller marketing headings, the sign-in title, the hero on phones.

groups.name: Voice
groups.note: The human voice. One italic word or short phrase inside a display headline, never a whole line, never in the app.

styles.name: voice-xl
styles.usage: The accented phrase inside a display-xl headline (set 4px larger to match the sans x-height).

styles.name: voice-lg
styles.usage: The accented phrase inside a display-lg or display-md headline.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: The app's working scale. Medium (500) for headings and labels, regular for text. At most three styles per section.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: App page titles and the calendar month.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Small headings, stepper titles, banner titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Poxeet learns how you write, plans a month of posts and publishes the ones you approve.
styles.usage: Marketing lead paragraphs under a display headline.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Most people never post because the blank box wins. Start with one honest sentence.
styles.usage: Default text, post text in the editor and preview.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Metadata, hints, table cells, calendar chips.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, buttons at size sm, badges, tabs.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section kickers and the eyebrow pill. Always set in capitals.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Numbers that line up: times, counts, key fragments.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Posting times, the character counter, the last four characters of a key.

spacing.note: 4px base. Sections breathe; controls stay tight.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside badges and chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label in buttons; gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Label to field; between related rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; the page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding at size md.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between groups inside a page; the page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections in the app.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Headline to product shot in the hero.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between marketing sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Between marketing sections on desktop.

radius.note: Soft and generous. Actions are pills; containers are rounded rectangles that grow with their size.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Calendar chips, keyboard keys, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, textareas, calendar day cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, banners, toasts, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, the modal, the calendar frame, feature cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Product shots and the hero frame on the landing page.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: The calendar board frame and the selected-day panel in the workroom.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, the eyebrow, switches, avatars.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of small buttons and segmented controls.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Height of default buttons, inputs and selects.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Height of hero buttons. Also the minimum touch target on phones.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content.

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Max width of post text and long copy.

shadow.note: Shadows mean floating. Resting cards use a hairline, not a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs at rest, the switch thumb.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the toast, calendar chips while dragged.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: The modal, the day panel, product shots floating over the hero wash.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px canvas gap, then 2px of solid brand, following the element's radius.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Workroom cards at rest: a whisper of edge and lift instead of a grey hairline.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Workroom cards on hover, popovers and the reschedule picker.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The calendar's selected-day panel, sheets and the modal: lifted off the lavender board.

motion.note: Short and functional. Everything is instant under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press and color changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Switches, tabs, panels appearing.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: The day panel sliding in. The maximum.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Every transition.

tokens.name: duration-enter
tokens.usage: Sheets and panels arriving.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Things arriving: sheets, the day panel, cards lifting on hover.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablets: display-xl drops to display-lg below this.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Desktop: the day panel becomes a side drawer.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Wide desktop.
